items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I always liked the clarinet chorus that he took on a noble sizzle record of I'm Just Wild About Harry.

ctx.x: Any other of his favorites that you think are extra good examples of his work?
I always liked the clarinet chorus that he took on a noble sizzle record of I'm Just Wild About Harry.
For real. I don't remember that. That was Decca, I guess, was it?
